title: DPS - Safety Performance Diagnosis
description: Field audit and expert assessment of your electrical risk management system. The DPS is the cornerstone of the CETé approach: analysis, rating, certification, and ongoing support for electrical safety and prevention.
shortDescription: On-site electrical risk audit - the foundation of your rating and certification
features: Analysis of organization and operational control on a representative worksite
Report with visual management across 4 reading levels
Recommendations and rating issued by the monitoring committee
Issuance of a certificate for all relevant purposes
Support for the improvement action plan
Newsletter subscription for the duration of certification

title: SAVE - Event Vulnerability Analysis Scan
description: Expert support for event analysis: accidents, close calls, near-misses, and hazardous situations. An independent perspective to understand and prevent.
shortDescription: Expert event analysis to understand and prevent incidents
features: Support for the improvement action plan

title: Campus CPF - Coaching, Performance, Training
description: The winning triptych of Performance: tailored advice and support to advance your teams and your organization.
shortDescription: The winning triptych: Coaching - Performance - Training

title: PASS-Sérénité VIP
description: Your privileged access to the CETé ADN ecosystem: regulatory monitoring, knowledge base, partner tools, and facilitation for your key contacts.
shortDescription: Privileged access to the CETé ADN ecosystem
features: Access to the CETé ADN VIP portal
Facilitation for supervisors and lead trainers
Eligibility for partner tools: Viz-Act, VISA, Vi.T.A.L, VESTA, VISU...

title: Vigi-Score - Independent Rating
description: Independent rating of your electrical risk management on the AAA-DDD scale. The core product of CETé.
shortDescription: Your official rating from AAA to DDD
features: Rating on the AAA to DDD scale
Detailed rating report by assessment axis

title: Executive & HSE Leadership Coaching
description: Supporting decision-makers in integrating electrical risk management into their operational strategy.

title: Live-Line Work Coordinator Coaching
description: Advanced training for live-line work coordinators to strengthen operational field expertise.

title: Site Supervision Coaching
description: Training for site managers and frontline supervisors in day-to-day electrical risk management.
shortDescription: Risk management at the operational level
features: Field training: 2 to 3 days per group

title: Training Organization Support
description: Methodological support and content for training organizations seeking to integrate the CETé framework into their curricula.
shortDescription: Integrating the CETé framework into your training programs

Content certified compliant with the CETé framework
